annotations.title: Read Code, Cloud, Data, Mobile, and Studio status

description: Reads this account’s Code, Cloud, Data, Mobile, and Studio snapshot, including ids and guidancePending on each owned row. The only action is that read, and it takes no arguments. Use status to see what exists and whether the one-time next-step ask is still pending. Use list_projects to list one product, project to read one row, and guidance with action ask when guidancePending is true. guidancePending true means that ask has not been recorded. Do not repeat the ask after guidance says it was already asked. This call does not create, deploy, delete, or charge.

inputSchema.description: No arguments. Call status with an empty object.
